model_twin.basis: CARRYING YOUR RECORD, NOT A FITTED MODEL: 1 instruction(s) the Owner wrote and 1 decision(s) the Owner made are handed to the Chief's prompt; nothing is trained, fitted or evaluated on them. The standing canon is also carried and is the PLATFORM's, identical for every Chief - it is not counted as this Owner's own declaration.
model_twin.method: a Chief CARRIES THE OWNER'S RECORD only when the Owner has written an instruction or made a recorded decision; nothing is modelled, trained or fitted in either case. This Chief carries it: 2 such input(s) are on record. `is_modelled_twin` (True) is the older name of `carries_owner_record` (True) and always equals it. The standing canon is carried either way and is the platform's, identical for every Chief, so it is never counted as this Owner's own declaration
